skeletonName: Interrupted diagonal returns and valley joins

plate.title: B32 · Banded diagonal courses and crossing rosettes
plate.description: The original interrupted diagonal courses lead every scale. Their separate central ends, diagonal half-drop and authenticated valley contacts remain intact. The disposition contains only those lines. Small fourfold diamond-petal rosettes in the other readings attach to the actual hook-start ports in the two opposed crossing families; the fine reading adds quiet petal midribs. Coordinate contact is a placement read, not a new source join. Broad and banded ink remains presentation of the retained courses, not a new ribbon face.
